title: Convex-Hull Instability of the $γ_2$-Functional in $L^p$
summary: For every $2 2$, both estimates in Talagrand's Research Problem~2.11.3 fail in each of the spaces $L^p[0,1]$ and $\ell_p$. The lower bound follows from a multilevel product principle applied to a scale-separated product of Euclidean simplices. The same construction gives the sharp convexification profile of $\ell_p^r(\ell_2^{2^{128r}})$ for $2<p\le\infty$ and, by finite representability, quantitative failure in every infinite-dimensional Banach space with cotype index greater than $2$.
